VI.description: Computes the order power spectrum of an even-angle signal. Wire data to the even-angle signal input to determine the polymorphic instance to use or manually select the instance.

Indicator.description: order power spectrum returns the averaged order power spectrum.

Control.description: even-angle signal specifies the even-angle-resampled data. even-angled signal is synchronous to the rotational speed with a constant number of samples per revolution.

Indicator.description: unit label returns the selected engineering units.

Control.description: error in describes error conditions that occur before this node runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.

Indicator.description: error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.

Control.description: restart averaging specifies if the selected averaging process has to be restarted. The default is FALSE. When you call this VI for the first time\2C the averaging process restarts automatically.

Control.type: cluster{uint16{No averaging,Vector averaging,RMS averaging,Peak hold}.averaging mode,uint16{Linear,Exponential}.weighting mode,uint32.number of averages,uint16{One shot,Auto restart}.linear mode}
Control.description: averaging parameters specifies how the averaging is computed. The specifications of the parameters include the type of averaging\2C the type of weighting\2C and the number of averages.

Indicator.description: averaging done returns TRUE when averages completed is greater than or equal to the number of averages specified in averaging parameters. Otherwise\2C averaging done returns FALSE. averaging done is always TRUE if the selected averaging mode is No averaging.
averages completed returns the number of averages completed by the VI at that time.

Indicator.type: cluster{string.channel name,string.description,uint16.x-axis units,cluster{uint16{FFT Spectrum [complex\5D,Amplitude [Magnitude\5D,Power [Magnitude^2\5D,Cross Spectrum [complex\5D,Frequency Response [Complex\5D}.spectrum type,uint16{linear,dB}.linear/dB,uint16.window,int32.window size,int32.FFT size}.spectral info,uint16.engineering units,string.custom label,double.dB reference [EU],uint16{rms,peak,peak-peak}.peak units,uint16.weighting filter,bool.spectral density?,string.unit label,bool.spectrum skewed?,uint16{none,radians,degrees,cycles,imaginary}.complimentary spectrum units}
Indicator.description: spectrum info returns information about the spectrum needed by the Spectrum Extended Measurements VIs\2C the Display VIs\2C and the Tone and Distortion VIs.

Control.description: dB on? specifies whether to return the resulting order power spectrum in decibels. If dB on? is FALSE\2C this VI returns the order power spectrum linearly. The default is TRUE.

Control.type: cluster{string.channel name,string.description,cluster{double.sensor sensitivity,uint16.engineering units,double.dB reference,string.custom label,uint16.weighting filter,double.pregain}. channel info}
Control.description: even-angle channel info specifies the information about the measurement configuration that this VI uses to acquire the resampled data.
window specifies the window this VI uses to compute the order power spectrum.
Control.items: None,Hanning,Hamming,Blackman-Harris,Exact Blackman,Blackman,Flat Top,4 Term B-Harris,7 Term B-Harris,Low Sidelobe,Gaussian

Control.description: block size specifies the block size of the even-angle signal this VI uses to compute the order power spectrum. The default is 1024.

Indicator.description: new spectrum available returns TRUE if order power spectrum contains a new measurement. When you wire this output value to the selector terminal of a Case structure\2C you can perform subsequent measurements or display this output value in the TRUE case of the Case structure.

Constant.type: cluster{bool.ignore dt,bool.ignore t0 continuity,bool.ignore array length,bool.ignore channel info,bool.ignore channel name}
